audience: All learners, before any trade task (cross-cutting)
description: Safety procedures every learner runs before any trade task: identify the hazards, select PPE, check the fit, work the task, and report. Grounded in the OSHA PPE topic page: PPE is equipment worn to minimise exposure to hazards; employers must provide it and train workers on when it is necessary, what kind, how to put it on / adjust / wear / take it off, its limitations, and its care, maintenance, useful life, and disposal; a PPE programme addresses hazards, selection, maintenance, use, training, and monitoring. Simulation only — not certification.

stations.title: Hazard board — hazard list for the bay
Safety station — PPE, first aid, extinguisher
Report desk — incident and near-miss log

steps.action: Hazard board: name the hazards in this bay before touching any tool.
Select the PPE the hazards call for (gloves, glasses, ear protection, hard hat, respirator as needed).
steps.check: PPE selected for every named hazard.

steps.action: Fit check: put PPE on, adjust it, and confirm it fits comfortably.
Work the task with PPE on; keep the floor clear and the first-aid point known.
Report: log the run and any near-miss at the report desk.
steps.check: Log complete; near-misses reported, not hidden.
